name: Rainy Grove
description: A fine, warm rain always falls beneath the grove's canopy, even on a clear day.

scenes.name: Dry Circle
scenes.description: A small circle of ground remains perfectly dry, although water drips continuously all around it.

scenes.name: Droplet-Covered Webs
scenes.description: Hundreds of spiderwebs stretch between the bushes, each droplet reflecting its own sky.

scenes.name: Singing Gutter
scenes.description: A hollow trunk collects rainwater and hums in a low, calm voice.
